description.en: Specifies whether the workspace has zone-redundant high availability (HA) resources.
The resource specifications for the zone-redundant HA configuration.

description.zh: 同城高可用备可用区vswitch组。
description.en: The vSwitch IDs for the secondary zone in the zone-redundant HA configuration.

descriptions.zh: 请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解实时计算Flink产品的[收费方式](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/flink/user-guide/reconfigure-resources?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6ebd18ea0MCC3t#task-2507532)和价格。
descriptions.en: Before you use this API, review the [billing methods](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/flink/user-guide/reconfigure-resources?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6ebd18ea0MCC3t#task-2507532) and pricing for Realtime Compute for Apache Flink.
